newsitem.title: USA: Carnival Air attendants vote to join AFA union.
newsitem.headline: Carnival Air attendants vote to join AFA union.

text.p: Flight attendants at Carnival Air Lines voted Thursday to be represented by the Association of Flight Attendants, AFL-CIO, union.
Of the 299 ballots cast, 286 votes were for AFA, the union said. The vote comes as the privately held Carnival Air is in a pending agreement to ba acquired by Pan Am Corp.
"We can now begin to work toward a contract for these flight attendants that will put them in step with the rest of the industry," AFA International President Pat Friend said in a statement.
AFA will represent the Carnival flight attendants in their future contract negotiations and during the proposed merger of Carnival and Pan Am.
The 354 Carnival flight attendants are based in Ft. Lauderdale, Fla., New York, and Puerto Rico.
Pan Am could not be reached immediately for comment.
